title: PTC Unveils a Wave of Product Innovations to Give Manufacturers New AI Capabilities and Connected Tools Across the Intelligent Product Lifecycle
summary: Introduces PTC Orbit and PTC Jetstream, a new AI platform, 12 AI agents, 10 new integrations, and 100+ enhancements across CAD, PLM, ALM, and SLM solutions Delivers the Intelligence Layer across the portfolio, giving manufacturers a stronger foundation for product data, deeper AI capabilities, and a more connected Intelligent Product Lifecycle PTC NEXT provides comprehensive portfolio updates twice a year, giving customers a predictable cadence to stay ahead and move forward with building their Intelligent Product Lifecycle PTC (NASDAQ: PTC) today announced its latest wave of product innovations to help customers move faster, build smarter products, and unlock more value from their data. Unveiled this week at the PTC NEXT™ Chicago event , the innovations include two new cross-portfolio products, a new AI platform, 12 new AI agents, 10 new integrations, and major updates to every product in PTC's portfolio, further advancing its Intelligent Product Lifecycle vision in ways customers
